headline: Două petroliere au explozii din cauza minelor în Ormuz, iar una se scufundă, potrivit Iranului
summary: Two oil tankers suffered strong explosions after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iran, and one, a supertanker, is reported to be sinking.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for seaborne crude and LNG, so incidents there affect global oil supply, shipping insurance and freight rates.
why_moved: The input reports tanker explosions from mines in the Strait of Hormuz, a major oil transit route, raising supply risk concerns.

original_headline: Dos petroleros sufren explosiones por minas en Ormuz y uno se hunde, según Irán
